name: Sovereignty stacks from Crimson Tide's damage (#603)
contract: Sovereignty 806049's single effect is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL (aura 42) on Sovereignty 504272, a native pair of modifiers (aura 108 MiscValue 14 SPELLMOD_COST BasePoints -11 and aura 107 MiscValue 17 SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS DieSides 1) whose EffectSpellClassMask (0, 131072, 0) is exactly the eight Bloodbolt ranks, StackAmount 5. Spell.dbc gives 806049 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so the aura was inert. The tooltip is 'Damage dealt by Crimson Tide now grants you Sovereignty' at ProcChance 100. Crimson Tide has no direct-damage effect at all, so the only event it can ever raise is PROC_FLAG_DONE_PERIODIC, which is what the row carries. Crimson Tide is cast as rank 504134, the rank a level-80 character owns per AscensionSpellProgressionData.h. Its single effect is aura 3 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DAMAGE with Amplitude 3000, DurationIndex 8 (15 s) and MaxAffectedTargets 10, so one cast against eight dummies produces 5 ticks x 8 targets = 40 separate PROC_FLAG_DONE_PERIODIC events, and two casts 15 s apart produce about 80. The first tick must therefore grant one stack, with no proc roll involved.
